why: Dais 2026-10-11: never change an Agent that has sold. Every version update to a seller (9/29 DeepSeek switch, 10/06, 10/10 price restore) preceded its sales stopping, and a seller update under review also fills one of the five new-Agent slots, so it blocks shipping new Agents too. The factory refuses to prepare, resume or submit these Agents for any reason (frozen_guard.sh, inventory_status.drop_frozen / drop_profitable_updates); no exception field bypasses this. Iterate only non-selling Agents; ship new Agents first; market the sellers.
